protocol.data_budget: same steps, batch size, length and splits for every model
protocol.selection: validation only; one held-out test evaluation
protocol.parameter_matching: same hidden width; actual parameter counts reported, not parameter matched
protocol.latency: batch forward; two warmups; synchronize CUDA after each measurement
protocol.quality_scope: synthetic tasks only; smoke scores do not establish learning superiority
protocol.optimization: PyTorch eager; Transformer uses native SDPA dispatch
protocol.energy: physical counters only; null when inaccessible; no TDP estimate
